frontmatter.name: Faheem Mushtaq
frontmatter.bio: Faheem Mushtaq is a software engineer and open source contributor at Layer5. He specializes in building intuitive and performant web applications, with a strong focus on design systems, developer experience, and usability. He is passionate about open source, design thinking, and creating tools that simplify and enhance the developer workflow.
